title: Thai-Style Pad Khao with Buttery Rice
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai dish made with lightly toasted buttery rice, savory pad khao, and a hint of spices. This recipe serves 4 as a main dish or 6 as a side.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pad khao and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped basil and cook for an additional minute.
Meanwhile, toast the buttery rice in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned.
Serve the pad khao over the toasted rice.
Drizzle with lightly salted butter and serve immediately.
Optional: Add protein of your choice (chicken, shrimp, tofu) and cook according to package instructions before serving.
